about: The Law Firm of Aaron A. Herbert is the one firm in this market that publishes a role for every attorney it names: a founding attorney, an associate attorney and an of counsel. It also publishes board certification in personal injury trial law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization, which is a claim about credentials rather than results.
Contingency fees, a free consultation and a 24 hour line, published. 252 reviews at 4.7.

G1.evidence: Texas does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: Texas does not publish a disciplinary register we can query.

G3.evidence: 1 physical location verified on Google Business Profile. We read the Active Franchise Taxpayers (data.texas.gov 9cir-efmm), published as open data by the Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts, which carries the Secretary of State file number, charter date and status and could not identify this firm in it: 40 entity name(s) contain the firm's name and none of them agrees on both the name and the city. A miss there is not evidence that the firm is unregistered, so this gate is unresolved rather than failed. The franchise tax does not reach a sole proprietorship or a general partnership, so this register can confirm an entity and cannot rule one out.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 3 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 252 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2015-06-08, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP
